entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A world of anthropomorphic animals with no humans, where animalfolk wear clothing, talk and wield magic; human planeswalkers are transformed into animals while there.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of the colorful companions who must redeem Bloomburrow from calamity.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: One of Mabel's companions on the quest.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: One of Mabel's companions on the quest.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: One of Mabel's companions on the quest.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: One of Mabel's companions on the quest.

entities.name: Glarb
entities.description: The King of Frogfolk and a powerful wizard, said to have insights about the calamity beasts.

entities.name: Great-Night Owl
entities.description: A threat to the realm that the adventurers must stop.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Elemental beasts threatening Bloomburrow, appearing as bears, boars, cats, wolves and others.

entities.name: Dragonhawk, Fate's Tempest
entities.description: A story-relevant creature, apparently the only Dragon on the plane.

entities.name: Dragonstorm Arc
entities.description: The story arc whose first set is Bloomburrow.

events.summary: A ragtag team of anthropomorphic adventurers band together on a quest to save the realm from elemental calamity beasts and the Great-Night Owl.
events.quote: A ragtag team of anthropomorphic adventurers must band together to go on an important quest to save the realm from elemental calamity beasts and the Great-Night Owl .

events.summary: It falls to Mabel and her companions Gev, Hugs, Finneas and Zoraline to redeem their world.
events.quote: It is now up to Mabel and her colorful companions Gev , Hugs , Finneas , and Zoraline to redeem their world.

relations.note: Glarb is King of the Frogfolk and is said to have insights about the calamity beasts.
relations.quote: Glarb , the King of Frogfolk and a powerful wizard, is said to have insights about the calamity beasts.
It is now up to Mabel and her colorful companions Gev , Hugs , Finneas , and Zoraline to redeem their world.

relations.note: The adventurers must save the realm from them.
